zh: 如果昨天早点出门，就不会迟到了。
old_en: If I had left home earlier yesterday, I wouldn't have been late.
new_en: If I had left home earlier yesterday, I wouldn't have been late.

zh: 如果知道会堵车，我就会坐地铁了。
old_en: If I had known it would be so busy, I would have taken the subway.
new_en: If I had known there would be traffic, I would have taken the subway.

zh: 要是早知道路上这么堵，我们就会坐地铁。
old_en: If we had known the road was so congested, we would have taken the subway.
new_en: If we had known the road was so busy, we would have taken the subway.

zh: 要是提前一个月订票，我们就能省不少钱。
old_en: If we had booked a month earlier, we would have saved a lot of money.
new_en: If we had booked the tickets a month earlier, we would have saved a lot of money.

zh: 如果当时听了你的建议，就不会犯这个错了。
old_en: If I had followed your advice, I wouldn't have made this mistake.
new_en: If I had followed your advice, I wouldn't have made this mistake.

zh: 要是早听你的，我就不会做错决定了。
old_en: If I had listened to you, I wouldn't have made the wrong decision.
new_en: If I had listened to you, I wouldn't have made the wrong decision.

zh: 如果那天没有加班，我就会去参加聚会了。
old_en: If I hadn't worked overtime that day, I would have gone to the party.
new_en: If I hadn't worked overtime that day, I would have gone to the party.

zh: 要是昨天早出门十分钟，我就不会迟到。
old_en: If I had left ten minutes earlier yesterday, I would have arrived on time.
new_en: If I had left ten minutes earlier yesterday, I wouldn't have been late.

zh: 如果当时带了伞，就不会淋雨了。
old_en: If I had brought an umbrella then, I wouldn't have gotten wet.
new_en: If I had brought an umbrella then, I wouldn't have gotten wet.

zh: 要是出门时带上伞，现在就不会感冒了。
old_en: If I had taken an umbrella when I went out, I wouldn't have caught a cold now.
new_en: If I had taken an umbrella when I went out, I wouldn't have caught a cold now.

zh: 如果当时多穿一件外套，就不会感冒了。
old_en: If I had worn an extra coat back then, I wouldn't have caught a cold.
new_en: If I had worn an extra coat, I wouldn't have caught a cold.

zh: 要是那天穿得厚一点，我就不会着凉。
old_en: If I had dressed warmer that day, I would not have caught a cold.
new_en: If I had dressed warmer that day, I wouldn't have caught a cold.

zh: 如果早点订票，就能买到便宜的机票了。
old_en: If we had booked the ticket earlier, we would have gotten a cheaper one.
new_en: If we had booked the ticket earlier, we would have gotten a cheaper one.

zh: 如果钥匙没忘在家里，我们现在就能进门了。
old_en: If we had left the keys at home, we would have been able to enter now.
new_en: If we hadn't left the keys at home, we could enter now.

zh: 要是带了钥匙，我们就能早点进去了。
old_en: If we had brought the keys, we would have entered earlier.
new_en: If we had brought the keys, we could have entered earlier.

zh: 要是考前多复习几天，我就能通过考试了。
old_en: If I had studied more days before the exam, I would have passed it.
new_en: If I had studied more before the exam, I would have passed it.

zh: 如果按时出发，我们就能赶上那班火车。
old_en: If we had left on time, we would have caught that train.
new_en: If we had left on time, we would have caught that train.

zh: 要是早十分钟出发，就不会错过火车了。
old_en: If we had left ten minutes earlier, we would have caught the train.
new_en: If we had left ten minutes earlier, we would have caught the train.

zh: 要是那天不加班，我们就能一起吃饭了。
old_en: If we hadn't worked late that day, we would have eaten together.
new_en: If we hadn't worked late that day, we could have eaten together.

zh: 如果平时多复习，这次就能考得更好。
old_en: If I had reviewed more regularly, I would have done better on this exam.
new_en: If I had reviewed more regularly, I would have done better on this test.
